title: Daily briefing: Fresh evidence for hidden chambers at Tutankhamun’s tomb
title_zh: 每日简报：图坦卡蒙墓穴新证据揭示隐藏房间
abstract: Scans support the idea that as-yet-unexplored chambers might hold the remains of the Egyptian queen Nefertiti. Plus, mathematical controversy and beautiful ctenophores.
abstract_zh: 扫描结果支持尚未探测的房间可能藏有埃及王后尼菲尔提的遗骸。此外，还涉及数学争议和美丽的水母类生物。
snippet: Scans support the idea that as-yet-unexplored chambers might hold the remains of the Egyptian queen Nefertiti. Plus, mathematical controversy and beautiful ctenophores.
